content_units: Movie Night Match Snapshot

Here are   8 strong picks   that fit your filters:   funny or suspenseful  ,   English-language  ,   1995–2022  ,   under 130 minutes  , and   no extreme gore  . I prioritized crowd-pleasers that work well for a mixed-age group of   15 to 60  .
Ranked Film Picks
Film   Year   Runtime   Tone   1-Sentence Premise   Why It Fits the Group   Content Note

Game Night   2018   100 min   Funny suspense   A friendly couples’ game night spirals into a real criminal mystery when one “fake” kidnapping turns out to be real.   Fast, witty, and easy for a group to enjoy because it mixes laughs with light thriller energy.   Violence is mild-to-moderate; some language and innuendo.

Knives Out   2019   130 min   Suspenseful/funny   A master detective investigates the death of a wealthy novelist while every eccentric family member becomes a suspect.   Clever, funny, and very discussion-friendly if your group likes guessing the culprit together.   Some strong language and brief non-graphic violence.

The Nice Guys   2016   116 min   Funny mystery   In 1970s Los Angeles, a bumbling private eye and a tough enforcer team up to investigate a missing girl and a larger conspiracy.   Great for adults who want sharp comedy and mystery without horror intensity.   Some sexual humor, language, and moderate violence.

Ocean’s Eleven   2001   116 min   Funny/cool suspense   A charismatic thief recruits a stylish team to pull off an elaborate casino heist in Las Vegas.   Smooth, entertaining, and broadly appealing with almost no heavy content.   Mild language and crime-related tension.

Spy   2015   120 min   Funny action   A desk-bound CIA analyst goes undercover and unexpectedly becomes the agency’s best shot at stopping a dangerous arms dealer.   Big laughs, brisk pacing, and accessible action make it ideal for a relaxed group watch.   Language, sexual jokes, and moderate action violence.

The Truman Show   1998   103 min   Funny/thoughtful suspense   A cheerful man gradually realizes his entire life may be a carefully controlled television production.   Works across ages because it is funny, smart, and suspenseful without being harsh.   Mild thematic intensity and brief emotional distress.

A Simple Favor   2018   117 min   Suspenseful/darkly funny   A mommy vlogger investigates when her glamorous best friend vanishes, uncovering layers of lies and manipulation.   Stylish and twisty for viewers who want suspense, with enough humor to keep it fun.   Mature themes, sexual content, language, and non-graphic violence.

See How They Run   2022   98 min   Funny mystery   In 1950s London, a weary inspector and an eager constable investigate a murder tied to a hit stage production.   Light, short, and easygoing, making it a safe pick if you want mystery without intensity.   Mild violence and some dark humor around murder.
Best Group-Friendly Choices
Top overall: Game Night
- Best if you want the most balanced   funny + suspenseful   option.
- Very approachable for a casual movie night and comfortably under your runtime limit.
Best mystery pick: Knives Out
- Best if your group enjoys   twists, clues, and post-movie discussion  .
- Right at   130 minutes  , so it just fits your cutoff.
Safest all-ages crowd pick: Ocean’s Eleven
- Best if you want something slick and entertaining with   minimal objectionable content   compared with the others.
- Especially good for mixed tastes and wider age spread.
Picking by Mood
-   Want the funniest option:    Game Night  or  Spy
-   Want the smartest whodunit:    Knives Out
-   Want stylish and easy to watch:    Ocean’s Eleven
-   Want suspense with a darker edge:    A Simple Favor
-   Want something lighter and shorter:    See How They Run
